title: Purpose Question Strategy

notes.html:
Purpose Question Examples

  • The primary purpose of the passage is to

  • The primary purpose of the third paragraph is to

  • The author draws an analogy between brain scans and X-rays primarily in order to

  • The author mentions a collage artist in the second paragraph primarily to
